title: feat(console): the All documentation page has the console's top bar, groups its books by app, and searches every article
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuBsvXiyTDYggWLQFR1qKw49)_

Fixes #35424

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTo4iDVWE2AcWkPm77 · Area: b1-CX

## 维护者速读

- 用户看到的变化：「全部文档」页（以及它下面的手册和文章页）换成和首页一样的顶栏「ObjectOS / 文档」，带搜索、通知、助手和头像菜单，可以直接回到任何应用；手册按应用分组，组名就是应用启动器里的名字；卡片上不再出现包 id；副标题和「9 篇」这样的计数跟随当前语言；页面右上角新增「搜索全部文档」，按标题、摘要和正文搜所有文章，结果里高亮命中的词，点开直接进到文章所在的手册。
- 系统包（如「系统设置」）的手册只挂在它的应用下面：成员的应用列表里没有这个应用，这页就不列它。这只是「列不列」，谁能读文档仍由服务端的受众规则决定，和以前一样。
- 最坏情况：只影响显示。全文搜索第一次输入时多一次 `GET /meta/doc?include=content` 请求（走和列表相同的受众规则）；撤回这个 PR 即恢复原样。
- 需要 Sales 做的：无。

## What changes

The "All documentation" half of #35424 (its items 6–9, design figure 26), plus three notes carried from #36000.

6. **The console's top bar on every portal page.** `/docs`, `/docs/<book>` and `/docs/<book>/<article>` now render inside Home's frame (`DefaultHomeLayout`, under the same organization / permissions layout as `/home`). The bar reads 「<product> / Documentation」 (a new `docs` variant of `AppHeader`; the crumb links to `/docs`) and keeps the centred search, inbox, assistant and avatar menu. The portal's own 「Documentation / <title>」 strip is gone (`DocShell` draws no bar off an app).
7. **Books grouped by app** (`groupBooksByApp`, `docs-index.ts`). A book goes under the first app whose navigation links to it (a `doc` entry naming the book or one of its articles, in `navigation`, nested `children` or `areas`, so a module's navigation contributions count), else under the first app of its package; books no app carries are listed last under 「Other documentation」. Groups are named as the launcher names the app (`useServedAppLabel`). **The subtitle and the counts read the session language** (「9 篇」), through new `help.*` keys with per-locale plural forms.
8. **No package id on any card.** A package's docs with no authored book are named by their app. A platform package's books (`com.objectstack.*`) are listed only under its app, so a member whose app list (`/meta/app`, already filtered by the server) has no such app does not see them listed. This is what the page lists, not who may read a doc: the server's audience gate decides that, as before.
9. **「Search all documentation」** (`searchDocs`, `useDocContents`). A search field on the page matches every listed article's title, summary and body (every word must match; title ranks above summary above body), and lists the matches with the words marked in context; each opens the article in its own book. Mermaid source and markup are not searched. The bodies are asked once, the first time the reader types (`GET /meta/doc?include=content`, which the server answers through the same audience gate as the slim list). The query stays in the URL (`?q=`). The label differs from the reader column's 「Search docs」.

Notes from #36000:

- **N3:** a hand-typed `/docs/<book A>/<article of book B>` now redirects to the article in its own book; with no book that holds it, the reader draws no previous / next pager instead of both ends at once (`bookHoldsArticle`).
- The portal reader passes `backLink={!docsNav}` to `DocShell`, so inside an app an article whose book is in no package keeps its 「← Back to <app>」 link.

`@objectstack/client`: `meta.getItems(type, { include })` (both the unscoped and the environment-scoped client) sends `?include=`; leaving it out sends nothing, as before. The options type is exported as `MetaItemsListOptions`. `@object-ui/app-shell`: `AppHeader` takes a `docs` variant; `DefaultHomeLayout` takes `variant`.

## Why

The maintainer's topic #34571, card #35424, figure 26: the "All docs" page had no way back to the apps (its own one-line bar), listed books flat with package ids (`com.objectstack.setup`), an English subtitle and counts under a Chinese session, the Setup book for every member, and no way to search across books.

## Verification

- Browser, against the showcase app (`objectstack dev --fresh`, console on vite), zh-CN, dark, 1280 × 800 and 375 × 812, `/docs`, `/docs?q=Markdown`, `/docs/manual`:
  - before: one bar 「文档」 with no search or menus; two flat cards, the second 「Setup」 with `com.objectstack.setup` under it; 「Books and guides from your installed packages.」 and 「8 articles」 in English; no search.
  - after: the bar 「ObjectOS 预览版 / 文档」 with search, inbox, help and avatar; groups 「功能展示」 (示例手册, 8 篇) and 「系统设置」 (系统设置, 1 篇); subtitle 「已安装应用自带的使用手册。」; 「Markdown」 finds 3 articles, each with its book and the word marked in the snippet; the reader under the same bar. At 375 px the bar folds to its phone form and the search sits under the title.
  - Screenshots (before / after, both widths) are kept with the card's evidence for the reviewer.
- Tests:
  - `docs-index.test.ts` (new): grouping by link, by package, the ungrouped group, a `doc` link counting as linking its book, platform books only under their app, no package id line; search word logic and ranking, listed-books filter, no diagram source or markup, snippet marking, CJK without spaces.
  - `docs-portal.test.tsx`: the real `DocsIndex` under the docs routes — groups and labels, the platform rule, search (URL, one content read for several queries, the article opened in its own book), search limited to listed books, the label differing from 「Search docs」, the N3 redirect with its control; the earlier collision pin now expects the redirect.
  - `AppHeader.centeredSearch-12472`, `AppHeader.aboutBuild-12970`, `AppHeader.searchTriggerNeedsPalette-11912`: the `docs` variant (centred search, the crumb to `/docs`, the about item, the palette gate); the home bar's control has no crumb.
  - `client.test.ts`: `include` sent as `?include=` on both getItems, nothing when left out.
  - `App.docsPortalLazy.test.tsx`: the portal stays lazy inside its new frame.
- `vitest`: `apps/console` docs files (61 tests), `packages/i18n` in full (parity, base keys, CLDR plural categories per pack), the app-shell layout and home tests, `packages/client` (223 tests): all passed. `tsc` for console, app-shell (with `tsconfig.test.json`) and client; `check:i18n-keys`; `eslint` over the changed files: 0 errors, no new warnings. zh-Hant regenerated with `gen:zh-hant`.
- `overlap-check.mjs`: clean against `origin/main` and the five open PRs sharing the locale files or `AppHeader.tsx` (#35968, #35994, #36018, #36024, #36026).

Clause-②: yes (widening) — @objectstack/client `meta.getItems` takes an optional `include` (`'content' | 'grants'`, sent as `?include=`) and exports its options type `MetaItemsListOptions`; @object-ui/i18n adds nine help.* keys (two of them plural, with their per-locale forms); nothing removed
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
